tech:ability-trainer.name: Ability Trainer
tech:ability-trainer.description: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains the effect until the tech ends.

tech:absolute-source-code-manipulation.name: Absolute Source Code Manipulation
tech:absolute-source-code-manipulation.description: Absolute Source Code Manipulation—A.S.C.M.—is the mightiest tech a runner can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires, altering the source code of reality at a fundamental level.

tech:absolute-terror-field.name: Absolute Terror Field
tech:absolute-terror-field.description: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs.

tech:access-root-critter.name: ACCESS_ROOT(Critter)
tech:access-root-critter.description: You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

tech:access-root-person.name: ACCESS_ROOT(Person)
tech:access-root-person.description: You attempt to use nanites and source code manipulation to influence a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

tech:access-root-target.name: ACCESS_ROOT(Target)
tech:access-root-target.description: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

tech:acid-shot.name: Acid Shot
tech:acid-shot.description: A shimmering holographic green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged tech attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn.

tech:acid-splurt.name: Acid Splurt
tech:acid-splurt.description: You hurl a small packet filled with caustic goo. Choose one or two creatures you can see within range. If you choose two, they must be within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

tech:adrenaline-boost.name: Adrenaline Boost
tech:adrenaline-boost.description: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the tech ends.

tech:aerial-advertisement.name: Aerial Advertisement
tech:aerial-advertisement.description: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words appear to be made of cloud or smog and remain in place for the tech’s duration. The words dissipate when the tech ends. A strong wind can disperse the clouds and end the tech early.

tech:aerobarricade.name: Aerobarricade
tech:aerobarricade.description: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration.

tech:aeroblast.name: Aeroblast
tech:aeroblast.description: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the tech’s duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the line.

tech:aerogrid.name: Aerogrid
tech:aerogrid.description: You seed an invisible grid of nanites in the air to create one of the following effects at a point you can see within range:

tech:aerokinesis.name: Aerokinesis
tech:aerokinesis.description: Using the aerial movement of nanites, you take control of the air in a 100-foot cube that you can see within range. Choose one of the following effects when you cast the tech. The effect lasts for the tech's duration, unless you use your action on a later turn to switch to a different effect. You can also use your action to temporarily halt the effect or to restart one you’ve halted.

tech:aerosol-stink-spray.name: Aerosol Stink Spray
tech:aerosol-stink-spray.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration.

tech:aerosurge-rampage.name: Aerosurge Rampage
tech:aerosurge-rampage.description: A whirlwind howls down to a point on the ground you specify. The whirlwind is a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on that point. Until the tech ends, you can use your action to move the whirlwind up to 30 feet in any direction along the ground. The whirlwind sucks up any Medium or smaller objects that aren’t secured to anything and that aren’t worn or carried by anyone.

tech:aimbot.name: Aimbot
tech:aimbot.description: You point a finger at a target in range. Your smart vision grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this tech hasn't ended.

tech:airdnd.name: AirDnD
tech:airdnd.description: You conjure a two-story tower made of stone, wood, or similar suitably sturdy materials. The tower can be round or square in shape. Each level of the tower is 10 feet tall and has an area of up to 100 square feet. Access between levels consists of a simple ladder and hatch. For some reason, the structure looks quite archaic. Each level takes one of the following forms, chosen by you when you cast the tech:

tech:alectos-drowning-call.name: Alecto's Drowning Call
tech:alectos-drowning-call.description: A mass of 5-foot-deep water appears and swirls in a 30-foot radius centered on a point you can see within range. The point must be on ground or in a body of water. Until the tech ends, that area is difficult terrain, and any creature that starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 6d6 bludgeoning damage and be pulled 10 feet toward the center.

tech:alright-fuck-this.name: Alright, Fuck This
tech:alright-fuck-this.description: You are immune to all damage until the tech ends.

tech:anomaly-analysis.name: Anomaly Analysis
tech:anomaly-analysis.description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the tech. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any techs are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a tech, you learn which tech created it. If you instead touch a creature throughout the casting, you learn what techs, if any, are currently affecting it.

tech:anomaly-detector.name: Anomaly Detector
tech:anomaly-detector.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of tech within 30 feet of you. If you sense tech in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears tech, and you learn its school of tech, if any.

tech:anonymous.name: Anonymous
tech:anonymous.description: Shadow-like nanites encase your body until the tech ends, causing you to become heavily obscured to others. The shadows turn dim light within 10 feet of you into darkness, and bright light in the same area to dim light.

tech:aperture.name: Aperture
tech:aperture.description: You create linked digital teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Choose two points on the ground that you can see, one point within 10 feet of you and one point within 500 feet of you. A circular portal, 10 feet in diameter, opens over each point. If the portal would open in the space occupied by a creature, the tech fails, and the casting is lost.

tech:appear-offline.name: Appear Offline
tech:appear-offline.description: Until the tech ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to software damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, observation techs, and the charmed condition. The tech even foils the absolute source code manipulation tech and techs or effects of similar power used to affect the target's mind, or to gain information about the target.

tech:arc-ricochet.name: Arc Ricochet
tech:arc-ricochet.description: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts.

tech:arcbarricade.name: Arcbarricade
tech:arcbarricade.description: You create a wall of hardlight thorns, tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration. You choose to make the wall up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick or a circle that has a 20-foot diameter and is up to 20 feet high and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight.

tech:arthropod-resizing.name: Arthropod Resizing
tech:arthropod-resizing.description: You use the biometric data of up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range to create giant hardlight versions of their digital forms for the duration. A centipede becomes a giant centipede, a spider becomes a giant spider, a wasp becomes a giant wasp, and a scorpion becomes a giant scorpion.

tech:auxiliary-system-flush.name: Auxiliary System Flush
tech:auxiliary-system-flush.description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

tech:babelfish.name: Babelfish
tech:babelfish.description: This tech grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

tech:backlight.name: Backlight
tech:backlight.description: Your bond empowers you with neon energy. Until the tech ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 neon damage on a hit.

tech:backup.name: Backup
tech:backup.description: This tech grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death. This clone forms inside a sealed vessel and grows to full size and maturity after 120 days; you can also choose to have the clone be a younger version of the same creature. It remains inert and endures indefinitely, as long as its vessel remains undisturbed.

tech:banning-strike.name: Banning Strike
tech:banning-strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this tech ends, your weapon crackles with force, and the attack deals an extra 5d10 kinetic damage to the target. Additionally, if this attack reduces the target to 50 hit points of fewer, you banish it. If the target is native to a different digital realm than the on you’re on, the target disappears, returning to its home realm. If the target is native to the digital realm you’re on, the creature vanishes into a harmless subrealm. While there, the target is incapacitated. It remains there until the tech ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

tech:bass-boost.name: Bass Boost
tech:bass-boost.description: You play a crusty audio byte with the bass turned all the way up, which can be heard 100 feet away. Each creature other than you within 5 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 thunder damage.

tech:bimbofication.name: Bimbofication
tech:bimbofication.description: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality. The target takes 4d6 software damage and must make an Intelligence saving throw.

tech:binary-ambush-diagnostic.name: Binary Ambush Diagnostic
tech:binary-ambush-diagnostic.description: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight.

tech:biohazard-barrier.name: Biohazard Barrier
tech:biohazard-barrier.description: You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random.

tech:biohazard-detector.name: Biohazard Detector
tech:biohazard-detector.description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case. The Tech can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

tech:biomechanical-hack.name: Biomechanical Hack
tech:biomechanical-hack.description: You send biomechanical disruptions coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:black-box.name: Black Box
tech:black-box.description: An immobile, faintly shimmering black box barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you and remains for the duration.

tech:black-hole.name: Black Hole
tech:black-hole.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of destructive gravitation force centered on a point you can see within range. For the tech's duration, the sphere and any space within 100 feet of it are difficult terrain, and nonmagical objects fully inside the sphere are destroyed if they aren't being worn or carried.

tech:blinding-strike.name: Blinding Strike
tech:blinding-strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this tech’s duration, your weapon flares with a bright light, and the attack deals an extra 3d8 neon damage to the target. Additionally, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the tech ends.

tech:brave-face.name: Brave Face
tech:brave-face.description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the Tech ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your Techcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the Tech ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points from this Tech.

tech:bucks-bad-trip.name: Buck's Bad Trip
tech:bucks-bad-trip.description: Projecting a deception powered by paranoia, you force a creature to hallucinate their worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration.

tech:buff.name: Buff
tech:buff.description: You buff up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the Tech ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

tech:buffed-weapon.name: Buffed Weapon
tech:buffed-weapon.description: You touch a nontechnical weapon. Until the tech ends, that weapon becomes a technical weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

tech:bug.name: Bug
tech:bug.description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the Tech ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find it.

tech:cacophonous-strike.name: Cacophonous Strike
tech:cacophonous-strike.description: The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this tech's duration, your weapon rings with thunder that is audible within 300 feet of you, and the attack deals an extra 2d6 thunder damage to the target. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and knocked prone.

tech:carapace-of-kelvin.name: Carapace of Kelvin
tech:carapace-of-kelvin.description: A protective force surrounds you, manifesting as a spectral frost that covers you and your gear. You gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage.

tech:cardioversion.name: Cardioversion
tech:cardioversion.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This tech can’t return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

tech:cataleptic-state.name: Cataleptic State
tech:cataleptic-state.description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death.

tech:caulk-coating.name: Caulk Coating
tech:caulk-coating.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this tech ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the technical vines until the tech ends. A Large or larger creature has advantage on this saving throw. If the target succeeds on the save, the vines shrivel away.

tech:ceramiron-skin.name: Ceramiron Skin
tech:ceramiron-skin.description: You touch a willing creature. Until the tech ends, the target’s skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target’s AC can’t be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.

tech:cha-cha-slide.name: Cha-Cha Slide
tech:cha-cha-slide.description: Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be charmed. On a failed save, a target is affected by this tech. Until the tech ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to designate a direction that is horizontal to you.

tech:charged-railgun-shot.name: Charged Railgun Shot
tech:charged-railgun-shot.description: A hyper-charged bullet streaks toward a creature within range, leaving a trail of energy in its wake. Make a ranged tech attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 kinetic damage.

tech:cheeky-holographic-shell.name: Cheeky Holographic Shell
tech:cheeky-holographic-shell.description: You project a hologram on a creature or an object you touch so that observation techs reveal false information about it. The target can be a willing creature or an object that isn't being carried or worn by another creature. When you cast the tech, choose one or both of the following effects. The effect lasts for the duration. If you cast this tech on the same creature or object every day for 30 days, placing the same effect on it each time, the deception lasts until it is dissipated.

tech:chill-the-fuck-out.name: Chill the Fuck Out
tech:chill-the-fuck-out.description: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects. You can suppress any effect causing a target to be charmed or frightened. When this tech ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime.

tech:chuuni-blade.name: Chuuni Blade
tech:chuuni-blade.description: Your whole body erupts with corruptive energy, your hand shaking, you can no longer contain your inner power! You clutch your eye, stating the words "No, my power, I can't contain it!" as your verbal and somatic components for this tech. You put on an eyepatch and weave together threads of data to create a sword of solidified energy in your hand. In the event that you do not have a physical eyepatch on you, a hardlight one materializes on your face. This "magic" sword (which in truth, is your OC's blade) lasts until the tech ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. It deals 2d8 software damage on a hit and has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 20/60). In addition, when you use the sword to attack a target that is in dim light or darkness, you make the attack roll with advantage, as the power of darkness and edge fuel your battle lust.

tech:cinch-cable.name: Cinch Cable
tech:cinch-cable.description: A cable manifests at your command in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. When you cast this tech, you can direct the cable to lash out at a creature within 30 feet of it that you can see. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 20 feet directly toward the cable.

tech:cloud-digitization.name: Cloud Digitization
tech:cloud-digitization.description: You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it’s wearing and carrying, into a digital cloud for the duration. The spell ends if the creature drops to 0 hit points. An incorporeal creature isn’t affected.

tech:cloud-prioritization.name: Cloud Prioritization
tech:cloud-prioritization.description: You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range assume a gaseous surge for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this cloud form, a creature has a flying speed of 300 feet and has resistance to damage from nonmagical weapons. The only actions a creature can take in this form are the Dash action or to revert to its normal form.

tech:colony-collapse.name: Colony Collapse
tech:colony-collapse.description: Choose one creature you can see within range, and choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the tech for its duration. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra 2d6 damage of that type. Moreover, the target loses any resistance to that damage type until the spell ends.

tech:combat-dressing.name: Combat Dressing
tech:combat-dressing.description: Healing a creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your Techcasting ability modifier. This Tech has no effect on hacked or machines.

tech:command-prompt.name: Command Prompt
tech:command-prompt.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The Tech has no effect if the target is a hacked, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it. Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the GM determines how the target behaves. If the target can't follow your command, the Tech ends.

tech:compliment-fishing.name: Compliment Fishing
tech:compliment-fishing.description: For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile toward you. If you roll a 1 on the ability or skill check, the creature realizes that you used tech and social pressure to influence its mood and becomes hostile toward you. A creature prone to violence might attack you. Another creature might seek retribution in other ways (at the DM's discretion), depending on the nature of your interaction with it.

tech:concrete-clutch.name: Concrete Clutch
tech:concrete-clutch.description: You choose a 5-foot-square unoccupied space on the ground that you can see within range. A Medium hand made from concrete rises there and reaches for one creature you can see within 5 feet of it. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained for the tech’s duration.

tech:concrete-geyser.name: Concrete Geyser
tech:concrete-geyser.description: Choose a point you can see on the ground within range. A fountain of churned concrete and stone erupts in a 20-foot cube centered on that point. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d12 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, the ground in that area becomes difficult terrain until cleared away. Each 5-foot-square portion of the area requires at least 1 minute to clear by hand.

tech:conspiracy-theory.name: Conspiracy Theory
tech:conspiracy-theory.description: This tech assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw when you cast this tech or be affected by it.

tech:construct-biomachine.name: Construct Biomachine
tech:construct-biomachine.description: While speaking an intricate incantation that you found on a weird website, you cut yourself with a jewel-encrusted dagger, taking 2d4 piercing damage that can’t be reduced in any way. You then drip your blood on the tech’s other components and touch them, transforming them into a special construct called a biomachine. It is your faithful companion, and it dies if you die. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can spend up to half your Hit Dice if the biomachine is on the same plane of existence as you. When you do so, roll each die and add your Constitution modifier to it. Your hit point maximum is reduced by the total, and the biomachine’s hit point maximum and current hit points are both increased by it. This process can reduce you to no lower than 1 hit point. and the change to your and the biomachine’s hit points ends when you finish your next long rest. The reduction to your hit point maximum can’t be removed by any means before then, except by the biomachine‘s death. You can have only one biomachine at a time. If you cast this tech while your biomachine lives, the tech fails.

tech:construct-firepit.name: Construct Firepit
tech:construct-firepit.description: You accelerate particles on the ground that you can see within range. Until the tech ends, a technical firepit fills a 5-foot cube. Any creature in the firepit's space when you cast the tech must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage. A creature must also make the saving throw when it moves into the firepit's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

tech:construct-hacked.name: Construct Hacked
tech:construct-hacked.description: You can cast this tech only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small humanoids within range. Each corpse becomes a ghoul under your control. The DM has game statistics for these creatures.

tech:construct-mecharionette.name: Construct Mecharionette
tech:construct-mecharionette.description: While casting the tech, you place a vial of quicksilver in the chest of a life-sized human doll stuffed with ash or dust. You then stitch up the doll and drip your blood on it. At the end of the casting, you tap the doll with a crystal rod, transforming it into a mecharionette clothed in whatever the doll was wearing. The type of mecharionette is chosen by you during the casting of the tech.

tech:contact-the-weirdos.name: Contact the Weirdos
tech:contact-the-weirdos.description: You mentally contact a powerful AI, virus, or hacked over the NET. Contacting this inhuman intelligence can strain or even break your mind. When you cast this tech , make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you take 6d6 software damage and are insane until you finish a long rest. While insane, you can’t take actions, can’t understand what other creatures say, can’t read, and speak only in gibberish. A primary system flush tech cast on you ends this effect.

tech:controlled-surge-mail.name: Controlled Surge Mail
tech:controlled-surge-mail.description: You summon a small surge to a spot within range. The surge is formless, nearly transparent, immune to all damage, and cannot interact with other creatures or objects. It carries an open, empty chest whose interior dimensions are 3 feet on each side. While the tech lasts, you can deposit as many items inside the chest as will fit. You can then name a living creature you have met and seen at least once before, or any creature for which you possess a body part, lock of hair, clipping from a nail, or similar portion of the creature’s body.

tech:coolant-storm.name: Coolant Storm
tech:coolant-storm.description: Until the tech ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused.

tech:counter-emp.name: Counter EMP
tech:counter-emp.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a tech. If the creature is casting a tech of 3rd level or lower, its tech fails and has no effect. If it is casting a tech of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your techcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the tech’s level. On a success, the creature’s tech fails and has no effect.

tech:crash-reboot.name: Crash/Reboot
tech:crash-reboot.description: You invoke the biochemistry of both death and life upon a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. Each creature of your choice in that area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 entropic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Nontechnical vegetation in that area withers.

tech:crashing-strike.name: Crashing Strike
tech:crashing-strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this tech's duration, your weapon pierces both body and mind, and the attack deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage to the target. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and can’t take reactions, until the end of its next turn.

tech:cryobarricade.name: Cryobarricade
tech:cryobarricade.description: You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for the duration.

tech:cryogenesis.name: Cryogenesis
tech:cryogenesis.description: You cause numbing cryogel to form on one creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 1d6 cold damage, and it has disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

tech:cryoshiv.name: Cryoshiv
tech:cryoshiv.description: You create a shard of ice and fling it at one creature within range. Make a ranged Tech attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard then explodes. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 cold damage.

tech:cryptoscam.name: Cryptoscam
tech:cryptoscam.description: When you cast this tech, you present the picture used as the material component and choose any number of creatures within range that can see you. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you until the tech ends, or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. While charmed in this way, a creature can do nothing but use its movement to approach you in a safe manner. While an affected creature is within 5 feel of you, it cannot move, but simply stares greedily at the picture you present.

tech:dampening-sludge.name: Dampening SLUDGE
tech:dampening-sludge.description: You have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage for the spell’s duration.

tech:dark-hole.name: Dark Hole
tech:dark-hole.description: This tech creates a sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere can have a radius of up to 40 feet. The area within this sphere is filled with technical darkness and crushing gravitational force.

tech:dark-web-aggregator.name: Dark Web Aggregator
tech:dark-web-aggregator.description: Name or describe a person, place, or object. The tech brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about the thing you named. The lore might consist of current tales, forgotten stories, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. If the thing you named isn’t of legendary importance, you gain no information. The more information you already have about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is.

tech:daybreak.name: Daybreak
tech:daybreak.description: The light of dawn shines down on a location you specify within range. Until the tech ends, a 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of bright light glimmers there. This light is considered equivalent to UV light. When the cylinder appears, each creature in it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this saving throw whenever it ends its turn in the cylinder. If you’re within 60 feet of the cylinder, you can move it up to 60 feet as a bonus action on your turn.

tech:deal-damage.name: Deal Damage
tech:deal-damage.description: Make a melee tech attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 Entropic Damage.

tech:death-stasis.name: Death Stasis
tech:death-stasis.description: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can’t become undead.

tech:debuff.name: Debuff
tech:debuff.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the Tech ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

tech:deconstruct-stone.name: (De)Construct Stone
tech:deconstruct-stone.description: You choose an area of stone or mud that you can see that fits within a 40-foot cube and that is within range, and choose one of the following effects.

tech:deconstruct-water.name: (De)Construct Water
tech:deconstruct-water.description: You either create or destroy water. Create Water. You fill the air with hydrogen creating up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames in the area. Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot cube within range.

tech:deconstruct.name: Deconstruct
tech:deconstruct.description: A mass of nanobots spring forth from your finger moving quickly towards a designated target. The target can be a creature, an object, or a creation of technical hardlight, such as the wall created by dynabarricade.

tech:detox.name: Detox
tech:detox.description: All non-magical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

tech:diagnostic-nanite-swarm.name: Diagnostic Nanite Swarm
tech:diagnostic-nanite-swarm.description: Healing nanites emerge from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the tech ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each non-hostile creature in the aura (including you) can’t become diseased, has resistance to poison damage, and has advantage on saving throws against effects that cause any of the following conditions: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned.

tech:digistruct-ai.name: Digistruct AI
tech:digistruct-ai.description: You manifest an A.I of challenge rating 4 or lower, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The A.I disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:digistruct-avatar.name: Digistruct Avatar
tech:digistruct-avatar.description: You touch a single computerized device or computer system to conjure an avatar—a partially sentient piece of software imprinted with vestiges of your own skills and computer abilities. For the duration of the tech, you can use a bonus action to have the avatar execute a computer related task that would normally require an action. The avatar makes Intelligence ability checks using your ability score and proficiency bonuses including your proficiency with hacking tools, if applicable.

tech:digistruct-macro-payload.name: Digistruct Macro Payload
tech:digistruct-macro-payload.description: You type foul words, summoning a single demon. You choose the demon’s type, which must be one of challenge rating 5 or lower, such as a shadow demon. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

tech:digistruct-micro-payloads.name: Digistruct Micro Payloads
tech:digistruct-micro-payloads.description: You utter foul and hateful words, summoning viruses from the chaos of the Hellsites. Roll on the following table to determine what appears.

tech:digistruct-micro-spam.name: Digistruct Micro Spam
tech:digistruct-micro-spam.description: You summon hardlight fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears:

tech:digistruct-micro-surges.name: Digistruct Micro Surges
tech:digistruct-micro-surges.description: You summon micro surges that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. You choose one the following options for what appears:

tech:digistruct-spam.name: Digistruct Spam
tech:digistruct-spam.description: You summon a spam creature of challenge rating 6 or lower, or a spam spirit that takes the form of a beast of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The spam creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:digistruct-surge.name: Digistruct Surge
tech:digistruct-surge.description: You digistruct a surge to serve your needs. Choose an area of air, earth, fire, or water that fills a 10-foot cube within range. A surge of challenge rating 5 or lower appropriate to the area you chose appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. For example, a plasma surge emerges from a bonfire, and a solid surge rises up from the ground. The surge disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:digital-binding.name: Digital Binding
tech:digital-binding.description: With this tech, you attempt to bind a AI, a surge, a spam, or a virus to your service. The creature must be within range for the entire casting of the tech. (Typically, the creature is first summoned into the center of an inverted net filter in order to keep it trapped while this tech is cast.) At the completion of the casting, the target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it is bound to serve you for the duration. If the creature was summoned or created by another tech, that tech’s duration is extended to match the duration of this tech.

tech:digital-cloaking.name: Digital Cloaking
tech:digital-cloaking.description: Four creatures of your choice within range become undetectable to electronic sensors and cameras for the duration of the tech. Anything a target is wearing or carrying is likewise undetectable as long as it is on the target’s person. The targets remain visible to vision.

tech:digital-containment.name: Digital Containment
tech:digital-containment.description: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of engrammatic code springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose.

tech:digital-daedalus.name: Digital Daedalus
tech:digital-daedalus.description: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine subrealm. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze.

tech:digital-dash.name: Digital Dash
tech:digital-dash.description: Briefly digitizing your body, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

tech:digital-penthouse.name: Digital Penthouse
tech:digital-penthouse.description: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its one entrance is located. The entrance shimmers faintly and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall. You and any creature you designate when you cast the tech can enter the extradimensional dwelling as long as the portal remains open. You can open or close the portal if you are within 30 feet of it. While closed, the portal is invisible.

tech:digital-resizing.name: Digital Resizing
tech:digital-resizing.description: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried. If the target is unwilling, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the tech has no effect.

tech:digital-streak.name: Digital Streak
tech:digital-streak.description: You digitally teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. On each of your turns before the tech ends, you can use a bonus action to teleport in this way again.

tech:digital-watchdog.name: Digital Watchdog
tech:digital-watchdog.description: You conjure a digital watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.

tech:digitize-thoughts.name: Digitize Thoughts
tech:digitize-thoughts.description: Putting a finger to your head, you pull a memory, an idea, or a message from your mind and transform it into a tangible micro-card of glowing data called a thought chit, which persists for the duration or until you cast this tech again. The thought chit appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you as a Tiny, weightless, semisolid object that can be held and stored like a disk. It is otherwise stationary.

tech:dislike.name: Dislike
tech:dislike.description: Making the traditional "thumbs down" gesture, you place a mark on a creature that you can see within range, subjecting them to the deadly dislike of your stream's followers. Until the tech ends, you deal an extra 1d6 entropic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack. Also, choose one ability when you cast the tech.

tech:dispersal-field.name: Dispersal Field
tech:dispersal-field.description: A strong wind (20 miles per hour) blows around you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you. The wind lasts for the tech’s duration.

tech:dma-beacon.name: DMA Beacon
tech:dma-beacon.description: You call forth lines of code that make up the lives of those who live, which flit around you for the tech’s duration. The lines are intangible and invulnerable.

tech:doolittles-dialog.name: Doolittle's Dialog
tech:doolittles-dialog.description: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, beasts can give you information about nearby locations and creatures, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived within the past day. You might be able to persuade a beast to perform a small favor for you, at the fixer's discretion.

tech:dry-ice-bombardment.name: Dry Ice Bombardment
tech:dry-ice-bombardment.description: A hail of frozen drone parts pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage and 4d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:dynabarricade.name: Dynabarricade
tech:dynabarricade.description: An invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick. It lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (your choice which side).

tech:electric-ammo.name: Electric Ammo
tech:electric-ammo.description: The next time you make a ranged weapon attack during the tech’s duration, the weapon’s ammunition, or the weapon itself if it’s a thrown weapon, transforms into a bolt of lightning. Make the attack roll as normal. The target takes 4d8 lightning damage on a hit, or half as much damage on a miss, instead of the weapon’s normal damage.

tech:electric-eye.name: Electric Eye
tech:electric-eye.description: The target gains true sight, able to see things others can't.

tech:emergency-barrier.name: Emergency Barrier
tech:emergency-barrier.description: An invisible barrier of technical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from micro seeker.

tech:emergency-booster.name: Emergency Booster
tech:emergency-booster.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your Techcasting ability modifier. This Tech has no effect on hacked or machines.

tech:emergency-deceleration.name: Emergency Deceleration
tech:emergency-deceleration.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the Tech ends. If the creature lands before the Tech ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet, and the Tech ends for that creature.

tech:emergency-evac.name: Emergency Evac
tech:emergency-evac.description: This tech allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this tech, you can take the Dash action as a bonus action on each of your turns until the tech ends.

tech:emergency-transfusion.name: Emergency Transfusion
tech:emergency-transfusion.description: You sacrifice some of your health to mend another creature’s injuries. You take 4d8 entropic damage, which can’t be reduced in any way, and one creature of your choice that you can see within range regains a number of hit points equal to twice the entropic damage you take.

tech:emp-field.name: EMP Field
tech:emp-field.description: A 10-foot-radius invisible electromagnetic sphere surrounds you. Within the sphere, techs can't be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and even tech items become mundane. Until the Tech ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you.

tech:endothermal-shot.name: Endothermal Shot
tech:endothermal-shot.description: You fire a super-cooled bullet toward a creature within range. Make a ranged tech attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

tech:energize-weapon.name: Energize Weapon
tech:energize-weapon.description: A nontechnical weapon you touch becomes a technical weapon. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For the duration, the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type when it hits.

tech:energy-barrier.name: Energy Barrier
tech:energy-barrier.description: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

tech:energy-converter.name: Energy Convertor
tech:energy-converter.description: The Tech captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. You have resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. Also, the first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering type, and the Tech ends.

tech:engage-hardware.name: ENGAGE(Hardware)
tech:engage-hardware.description: You endow yourself with endurance and martial prowess fueled by a high powered program. Until the program ends, you can’t use any other tech due to the file size and power needed to run the program, and you gain the following benefits:

tech:engage-kaiju.name: ENGAGE(Kaiju)
tech:engage-kaiju.description: With a roar, you draw on the tech of kaiju to transform yourself, taking on kaiju-like features. You gain the following benefits until the spell ends:

tech:engage-software.name: ENGAGE(Software)
tech:engage-software.description: Entering a forbidden code, you draw on the technology of the Net Realm or Digital Wastes (your choice) to transform yourself. You gain the following benefits until the tech ends:

tech:engram-encryption.name: Engram Encryption
tech:engram-encryption.description: This spell snatches the soul of a humanoid as it dies and traps it inside the tiny cage you use for the material component. A stolen soul remains inside the cage until the tech ends or until you destroy the cage, which ends the tech. While you have a soul inside the cage, you can exploit it in any of the ways described below. You can use a trapped soul up to six times. Once you exploit a soul for the sixth time, it is released, and the tech ends. While a soul is trapped, the dead humanoid it came from can’t be revived.

tech:engram-roulette.name: Engram Roulette
tech:engram-roulette.description: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid. Provided that the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, the tech forms a new adult body for it and then calls the soul to enter that body. If the target’s soul or engram isn’t free or willing to do so, the tech fails.

tech:engrammatic-digitization.name: Engrammatic Digitization
tech:engrammatic-digitization.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your consciousness into the local digital space. The material body you leave behind is unconscious and in a state of suspended animation; it doesn’t need food or air and doesn’t age.

tech:engrammatic-katana.name: Engrammatic Katana
tech:engrammatic-katana.description: You create a katana-shaped engram of pure code that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration.

tech:engrammatic-reload.name: Engrammatic Reload
tech:engrammatic-reload.description: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less. The tech leaves an invisible mark on its surface and invisibly inscribes the name of the item on the sapphire you use as the material component. Each time you cast this tech, you must use a different sapphire.

tech:engrammatic-stash.name: Engrammatic Stash
tech:engrammatic-stash.description: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Digital Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serves as a material component for the tech. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet).

tech:enter-sandman.name: Enter Sandman
tech:enter-sandman.description: This tech shapes a creature’s dreams. Choose a creature known to you as the target of this tech. The target must be in the same digital realm as you, or you must both be in the physical world. Creatures that don’t sleep, such as elves or remakes, can’t be contacted by this tech. You, or a willing creature you touch, enters a trance state, acting as a messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is aware of their surroundings, but can’t take actions or move.

tech:enter-the-mainframe.name: Enter the Mainframe
tech:enter-the-mainframe.description: You gain advantage on all Intelligence checks using hacking tools to break software encryption or online security when using a foreign system.

tech:entropic-blast.name: Entropic Blast
tech:entropic-blast.description: A sphere of entropic energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point within range. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. A target takes 8d6 entropic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:entropic-virus.name: Entropic Virus
tech:entropic-virus.description: You unleash a disintegrating hardlight virus in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged tech attack against the creature to assail it with vicious hardlight microshards. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 entropic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Until then, the virus clings to the target.

tech:enveloping-esurience.name: Enveloping Esurience
tech:enveloping-esurience.description: You open a gateway to an unknown, unspeakable digital sub-realm, one filled with horrors and perversions alike. A 20-foot-radius sphere of darkness and sickly cold appears, centered on a point with range and lasting for the duration. This void is filled with a cacophony of soft whispers and slurping noises that can be heard up to 30 feet away. No light, technical or otherwise, can illuminate the area, and creatures fully within the area are blinded.

tech:environmental-avatar.name: Environmental Avatar
tech:environmental-avatar.description: An AI answers your call and transforms you into a powerful avatar. The transformation lasts until the tech ends. You choose one of the following forms to assume: Primal Beast or Great Tree.

tech:environmental-protest.name: Environmental Protest
tech:environmental-protest.description: You rouse the environment against your enemies. Choose a point you can see within range. The nanites cause trees, rocks, and grasses in a 60-foot cube centered on that point to become animated until the spell ends.

tech:erase-rewind.name: Erase/Rewind
tech:erase-rewind.description: When you cast this tech, you skillfully reshape the memories of listeners in your immediate area, so that each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you forgets everything you said within the last 6 seconds. Those creatures then remember that you actually said the words you speak as the verbal component of the tech.

tech:esc-cloud.name: ESC:Cloud
tech:esc-cloud.description: Wind wraps around your body, tugging at your hair and clothing as your feet lift off the ground. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet. Additionally, you have advantage on ability checks to avoid being grappled, and on saving throws against being restrained or paralyzed.

tech:esc-dubstep.name: ESC:Dubstep
tech:esc-dubstep.description: You digitally teleport yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within range. Immediately after you disappear, a thunderous boom sounds, and each creature within 10 feet of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d10 thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The thunder can be heard from up to 300 feet away.

tech:esc-torrent.name: ESC:Torrent
tech:esc-torrent.description: You conjure a deluge of digital seawater in a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within range. This water takes the form of a tidal wave, a whirlpool, a waterspout, or another form of your choice. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your tech save DC or take 2d8 bludgeoning damage and fall prone. You can choose a number of creatures equal to your techcasting modifier (minimum of 1) to automatically succeed on this saving throw.

tech:etherealnetwork.name: Etherealnetwork
tech:etherealnetwork.description: You encode yourself into a digital engram, using the Dark Web to traverse the real world. You remain in the Dark Web for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the tech. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can see and hear the real world, but everything there looks gray, and you can't see anything more than 60 feet away.

tech:event-horizon.name: Event Horizon
tech:event-horizon.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of crushing force forms at a point you can see within range and tugs at the creatures there. Each creature in the sphere must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 5d10 force damage, and is pulled in a straight line toward the center of the sphere, ending in an unoccupied space as close to the center as possible (even if that space is in the air). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pulled.

tech:excavate.name: Excavate
tech:excavate.description: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar. The extent of any such changes can't exceed half the area's largest dimension. So, if you affect a 40-foot square, you can create a pillar up to 20 feet high, raise or lower the square's elevation by up to 20 feet, dig a trench up to 20 feet deep, and so on. It takes 10 minutes for these changes to complete.

tech:exothermal-strike.name: Exothermal Strike
tech:exothermal-strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the tech’s duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity, and the attack deals an extra 1d6 fire damage to the target and causes the target to ignite in flames.

tech:expedite.name: Expedite
tech:expedite.description: This tech allows you to impart onto another, or yourself, the exact workings of the local digital realms in relation to the near future of the triggering tech. Such information allows the initial casting to be altered in line with these algorithmic predictions of the future to bring the process about more efficiently. The triggering tech is considered to have been cast a number of days equal to your techcasting ability modifier in addition to today's triggering casting. A creature can not benefit from this tech again by any means, until 24 hours have passed.

tech:fairy-lights.name: Fairy Lights
tech:fairy-lights.description: Seven fairy-like motes of light digitize and orbit your head until the tech ends. You can use a bonus action to send one of the motes streaking toward one creature or object within 120 feet of you. When you do so, make a ranged tech attack. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 radiant damage. Whether you hit or miss, the mote is expended. The tech ends early if you expend the last mote. If you have four or more motes remaining, they shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. If you have one to three motes remaining, they shed dim light in a 30-foot radius.

tech:faraday-field.name: Faraday Field
tech:faraday-field.description: Invisible protective nanites swirl around you, distorting and diffusing technical energy within 30 feet of you. Until the tech ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you. For the duration, each friendly creature in the area (including you) has advantage on saving throws against tech and other technical effects.

tech:feedback-edge.name: Feedback Edge
tech:feedback-edge.description: As part of the action used to cast this tech, you must make a melee attack with a weapon against one creature within the tech's range, otherwise the tech fails. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it becomes sheathed in high-frequency vibrations until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves before then, it immediately takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the tech ends.

tech:feral-sludge.name: Feral SLUDGE
tech:feral-sludge.description: You sculpt a custom dose of SLUDGE into sharp claws or fangs around your hand or mouth, ready to deliver a gooey attack. Make a melee tech attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 acid damage. After you make the attack, your hand or mouth returns to normal.

tech:ferrobarricade.name: Ferrobarricade
tech:ferrobarricade.description: You create a vertical wall of whirling, hardlight, razor-sharp blades. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You can make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides three-quarters cover to creatures behind it, and its space is difficult terrain.

tech:ferrofluid-tentacles.name: Ferrofluid Tentacles
tech:ferrofluid-tentacles.description: Ferrofluis tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, these tentacles turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

tech:find-vehicle.name: Find Vehicle
tech:find-vehicle.description: You digistruct a creation that assumes the form of a nonmilitary land vehicle of your choice, appearing in an unoccupied space within range. The vehicle has the statistics of a normal vehicle of its sort, though it is an AI, spam or virus (your choice in origin). The physical characteristics of the vehicle reflect its origin to some degree. For example, a virus SUV might be jet black in color, with tinted windows and a sinister-looking front grille.

tech:flak-cannon.name: Flak Cannon
tech:flak-cannon.description: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before the tech ends, this tech creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition. In addition to the normal effect of the attack, the target of the attack and each creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 1d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:flame-vent.name: Flame Vent
tech:flame-vent.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

tech:flamedash.name: Flamedash
tech:flamedash.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons (Ashardalon's Stride)

tech:flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
tech:flamethrower.description: A line of roaring flame 30 feet long and 5 feet wide emanates from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:flash-bang.name: Flash/Bang
tech:flash-bang.description: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the tech ends.

tech:flash-freeze.name: Flash Freeze
tech:flash-freeze.description: A burst of cold nitrocoolant emanates from you in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d8 cold damage and is hindered by ice formations for 1 minute, or until it or another creature within reach of it uses an action to break away the ice. A creature hindered by ice has its speed reduced to 0. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t hindered by ice.

tech:fluorescent-discharge.name: Fluorescent Discharge
tech:fluorescent-discharge.description: You spit such a hot take you ignite the fluoresence of a broken light bulb. Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 neon damage.

tech:forced-redirect.name: Forced Redirect
tech:forced-redirect.description: Source: Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos (Vortex Warp)

tech:fortify.name: Fortify
tech:fortify.description: A fortress of stone erupts from a square area of ground of your choice that you can see within range. The area is 120 feet on each side, and it must not have any buildings or other structures on it. Any creatures in the area are harmlessly lifted up as the fortress rises.

tech:frost-emission.name: Frost Emission
tech:frost-emission.description: Freezing cold blasts from your fingertips in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:full-auto.name: Full Auto
tech:full-auto.description: You use nanites to transmute your quiver, clip or magazine so it produces an endless supply of non technical ammunition, which seems to leap into your hand or weapon when you reach for it or load it.

tech:fullerene-skin.name: Fullerene Skin
tech:fullerene-skin.description: This tech gifts a willing creature you touch a skin of ceramic ablative armor. Until the tech ends, the target has resistance to nontechnical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

tech:gambit.name: Gambit
tech:gambit.description: Choose a tech of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action, and that can target you. You cast that tech—called the gambit tech—as part of casting gambit, expending tech slots for both, but the gambit tech doesn’t come into effect. Instead, it takes effect when a certain circumstance occurs. You describe that circumstance when you cast the two techs. For example, a gambit cast with oxygen filter might stipulate that oxygen filter comes into effect when you are engulfed in water or a similar liquid.

tech:gas-self-surge.name: Gas Self-Surge
tech:gas-self-surge.description: Until the tech ends, wind whirls around you, and you gain the following benefits:

tech:gasoline-ballet.name: Gasoline Ballet
tech:gasoline-ballet.description: A storm made up of sheets of roaring flame appears in a location you choose within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish. Each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 7d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:gate-of-babylon.name: Gate of Babylon
tech:gate-of-babylon.description: You fire a piece of nontechnical ammunition from a ranged weapon or throw a nontechnical weapon into the air and choose a point within range. Hundreds of duplicates of the ammunition or weapon fall in a volley from above and then disappear. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage type is the same as that of the ammunition or weapon.

tech:geobarricade.name: Geobarricade
tech:geobarricade.description: A wall of solid stone is fabricated by your nanomachines at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with at least one other panel. Alternatively, you can create 10-foot-by-20-foot panels that are only 3 inches thick.

tech:geomesh.name: Geomesh
tech:geomesh.description: You choose a portion of synth-soil or concrete (or natural dirt or stone) that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube, injecting a mesh of hardlight influence. You manipulate it in one of the following ways:

tech:geosurge-rampage.name: Geosurge Rampage
tech:geosurge-rampage.description: You create a seismic disturbance at a point on the ground that you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point and shakes creatures and structures in contact with the ground in that area.

tech:ghost-in-the-machine.name: Ghost in the Machine
tech:ghost-in-the-machine.description: This tech works to actively hide your presence within a computer system. For the tech’s duration, you and any other users you choose on your local network gain a +10 bonus to Intelligence checks to avoid detection by administrators, knowbots, tracking software, and the like. Whenever you and your chosen users leave any computer system you are working in while this tech is in effect, all trace of your previous presence in that system is erased.

tech:glitch.name: Glitch
tech:glitch.description: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you poison their minds with images of dark creatures, visible only to them.

tech:glow-bots.name: Glow-Bots
tech:glow-bots.description: You create up to four tiny luminescent drones within range, making them appear as glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

tech:good-vibes.name: Good Vibes
tech:good-vibes.description: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your techcasting ability modifier. This tech has no effect on hacked or constructs.

tech:goodburger.name: Goodburger™
tech:goodburger.description: Up to ten smashburger sliders, individually wrapped, appear in your hand and are infused with energy for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one slider. Eating a slider restores 1 hit point, and the slider provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day. The sliders lose their potency if they have not been consumed within 24 hours of the casting of this tech.

tech:gravitron.name: Gravitron
tech:gravitron.description: The gravity in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within range increases for a moment. Each creature in the sphere on the turn when you cast the tech must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 force damage, and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no reduction to its speed.

tech:gtfo.name: GTFO
tech:gtfo.description: The air quivers around up to five creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist this tech. You teleport each affected target to an unoccupied space that you can see within 120 feet of you. That space must be on the ground or on a floor.

tech:guiding-code.name: Guiding Code
tech:guiding-code.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the tech ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The tech then ends.

tech:hack-stuff.name: Hack Stuff
tech:hack-stuff.description: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nontechnical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can’t animate any object larger than Huge. Each target animates and becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points.

tech:hardlight-armor.name: Hardlight Armor
tech:hardlight-armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the Tech ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The Tech ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the Tech as an action.

tech:hardlight-burning-blade.name: Hardlight Burning Blade
tech:hardlight-burning-blade.description: You project a fiery hardlight blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a machete, and it lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke the blade again as a bonus action. You can use your action to make a melee tech attack with the fiery blade.

tech:hardlight-chicanery.name: Hardlight Chicanery
tech:hardlight-chicanery.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The deception also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this tech again.

tech:hardlight-energy-barrier.name: Hardlight Energy Barrier
tech:hardlight-energy-barrier.description: You create a field of silvery light that surrounds a creature of your choice within range (you can choose yourself). The field sheds dim light out to 5 feet. While surrounded by the field, a creature gains the following benefits:

tech:hardlight-steed.name: Hardlight Steed
tech:hardlight-steed.description: A Large quasi-real, four-legged creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. You decide the creature’s appearance, but it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle. Any of the equipment created by the tech vanishes in a puff of smoke if it is carried more than 10 feet away from the steed.

tech:hardlight-terrain.name: Hardlight Terrain
tech:hardlight-terrain.description: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The terrain’s general shape remains the same, however. Open fields or a road could be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road.

tech:hardlock.name: Hardlock
tech:hardlock.description: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone. If the target's body is made of flesh, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained as its flesh begins to harden. On a successful save, the creature isn’t affected.

tech:harmonious-nanite-swarm.name: Harmonious Nanite Swarm
tech:harmonious-nanite-swarm.description: Nanite-bots exit from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the tech ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each non-hostile creature in the aura (including you) has resistance to entropic damage, and its hit point maximum can’t be reduced. In addition, a non-hostile, living creature regains 1 hit point when it starts its turn in the aura with 0 hit points.

tech:haywire.name: Haywire
tech:haywire.description: This tech plays havoc with electronic devices, making the use of such devices all but impossible. Each electronic device in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range is subject to random behavior while it remains within the area. A device not held by a creature is automatically affected. If an electronic device is held by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the device affected by the tech.

tech:hazardous-nanoswarm.name: Hazardous Nanoswarm
tech:hazardous-nanoswarm.description: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere spreads around corners. The sphere remains for the duration, and its area is lightly obscured. The sphere’s area is difficult terrain.

tech:heartless-roasting.name: Heartless Roasting
tech:heartless-roasting.description: You unleash a string of insults so foul at a creature you can see within range that a sewage spire looks pristine by comparison. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 software damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

tech:heatlamp.name: Heatlamp
tech:heatlamp.description: A flickering hardlight flame, produced by a heatlamp application, appears at the end of your finger. The lampflame remains there for the duration and harms neither you nor your equipment. The lampflame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The tech ends if you dismiss it as an action or if you cast it again.

tech:hefty-hittin-hand.name: Hefty Hittin' Hand
tech:hefty-hittin-hand.description: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the tech's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand.

tech:heighten-reflexes.name: Heighten Reflexes
tech:heighten-reflexes.description: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target can add 1d8 to its initiative rolls.

tech:hellofeast.name: HelloFeast™
tech:hellofeast.description: You bring forth a great Feast™, including magnificent food and drink. The Feast™ takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don’t set in until this hour is over. Up to twelve creatures can partake of the Feast™.

tech:hitscan.name: Hitscan
tech:hitscan.description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area when the Tech is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a Dexterity saving throw.

tech:holo-images.name: Holo-Images
tech:holo-images.description: Three holographic duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the tech ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it’s impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.

tech:holo-projected-terrain.name: Holo-Projected Terrain
tech:holo-projected-terrain.description: You make digital terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of digital terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures within the area aren't changed in appearance.

tech:holographic-decoy.name: Holographic Decoy
tech:holographic-decoy.description: You become invisible at the same time that an deception double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends if you attack or cast a tech.

tech:holographic-flame.name: Holographic Flame
tech:holographic-flame.description: A holographic flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn’t use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

tech:homing-spark.name: Homing Spark
tech:homing-spark.description: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a ranged tech attack against that creature.
