On a hit, the target takes 1d12 lightning damage, and on each of your turns for the duration, you can use your action to deal 1d12 lightning damage to the target automatically. The tech ends if you use your action to do anything else. The tech also ends if the target is ever outside the tech's range or if it has total cover from you.

tech:hot-shots.name: Hot Shots
tech:hot-shots.description: You create six tiny hardlight meteor-shaped explosives in your space. They float in the air and orbit you for the spell’s duration. When you cast the spell — and as a bonus action on each of your turns thereafter — you can expend one or two of the meteors, sending them streaking toward a point or points you choose within 120 feet of you. Once a meteor reaches its destination or impacts against a solid surface, the meteor explodes. Each creature within 5 feet of the point where the meteor explodes must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 2d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:hot-take.name: Hot Take
tech:hot-take.description: For the tech’s duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with entropic power, as you spit the hottest of takes. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration. On each of your turns until the tech ends, you can use your action to target another creature but can’t target a creature again if it has succeeded on a saving throw against this casting of hot take.

tech:hover-bots.name: Hover Bots
tech:hover-bots.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the tech ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.

tech:hovering-helping-hand.name: Hovering Helping Hand
tech:hovering-helping-hand.description: You release a remote-controlled floating hand at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand deactivates if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this tech again.

tech:hoverlift.name: Hoverlift
tech:hoverlift.description: This tech creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The hoverlift remains for the duration, and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the tech ends, and everything on the hoverlift falls to the ground.

tech:hr-video.name: HR Video
tech:hr-video.description: Choose up to five creatures within range that can hear you. For the duration, each affected creature gains 5 temporary hit points and has advantage on Wisdom saving throws. If an affected creature is hit by an attack, it has advantage on the next attack roll it makes. Once an affected creature loses the temporary hit points granted by this tech, the tech ends for that creature.

tech:hydraulic-boost.name: Hydraulic Boost
tech:hydraulic-boost.description: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the Tech ends.

tech:hydrobarricade.name: Hydrobarricade
tech:hydrobarricade.description: You conjure up a wall of water on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or you can make a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall vanishes when the tech ends. The wall’s space is difficult terrain.

tech:hydrokinesis.name: Hydrokinesis
tech:hydrokinesis.description: Until the tech ends, you use nanotech swarmbots to control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can choose from any of the following effects when you cast this tech. As an action on your turn, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

tech:hydroscript.name: Hydroscript
tech:hydroscript.description: You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube and feed a script into its liquid form. You manipulate it in one of the following ways:

tech:hydrosurge-rampage.name: Hydrosurge Rampage
tech:hydrosurge-rampage.description: A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick. The wall lasts for the duration.

tech:impenetrable-dome.name: Impenetrable Dome
tech:impenetrable-dome.description: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of hardlight panels springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The tech ends if you leave its area.

tech:impenetrable-sphere.name: Impenetrable Sphere
tech:impenetrable-sphere.description: A sphere of shimmering tech encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration.

tech:incendiary-ammo.name: Incendiary Ammo
tech:incendiary-ammo.description: You touch a magazine containing bullets or another type of ammunition. When a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using a piece of ammunition drawn from the magazine, the target takes an extra 1d6 fire damage. The tech's effect ends on the piece of ammunition when it hits or misses, and the spell ends when twelve pieces of ammunition have been used from the magazine.

tech:incendiary-blast.name: Incendiary Blast
tech:incendiary-blast.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried.

tech:incendiary-canister.name: Incendiary Canister
tech:incendiary-canister.description: You throw a satchel of remotely triggered C4 explosives at a chosen point within range. When the tech ends, either because your concentration is broken or because you decide to end it, the C4 bursts into an explosion of flame that spreads around corners. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes fire damage equal to the total accumulated damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:incendiary-salvo.name: Incendiary Salvo
tech:incendiary-salvo.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged tech attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage.

tech:incendiary-shot.name: Incendiary Shot
tech:incendiary-shot.description: You fire an incendiary bullet at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged tech attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this tech ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

tech:incognito.name: Incognito
tech:incognito.description: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from observation tech. The target can be a willing creature or a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can’t be targeted by any observation tech or perceived through technical sensors.

tech:infallible-relay.name: Infallible Relay
tech:infallible-relay.description: With this spell, you can target any creature with whom you have spoken previously, as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. When you cast the spell, the nearest functioning telephone or similar communications device within 100 feet of the target begins to ring. If there is no suitable device close enough to the target, the spell fails.

tech:infodump.name: Infodump
tech:infodump.description: You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw. Any creature that can’t be charmed succeeds on this saving throw automatically, and if you or your companions are fighting a creature, it has advantage on the save. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the tech ends or until the target can no longer hear you. The tech ends if you are incapacitated or can no longer speak.

tech:injure.name: Injure
tech:injure.description: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 entropic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The damage can’t reduce the target’s hit points below 1. If the target fails the saving throw, its hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour by an amount equal to the entropic damage it took. Any effect that removes a disease allows a creature’s hit point maximum to return to normal before that time passes.

tech:integration-error.name: Integration Error
tech:integration-error.description: You cause a datacloud of bugs, glitches, and other code-exceptions to momentarily integrate into one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it takes 1d6 poison damage and moves 5 feet in a random direction if it can move and its speed is at least 5 feet. Roll a d4 for the direction: 1, north; 2, south; 3, east; or 4, west. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and if the direction rolled is blocked, the target doesn't move.

tech:intrasquad-telecomms.name: Intrasquad Telecomms
tech:intrasquad-telecomms.description: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration. Creatures with Intelligence scores of 2 or less aren’t affected by this tech.

tech:invisi-pet.name: Invisi-Pet
tech:invisi-pet.description: This Tech creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command until the Tech ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, and a Strength of 2, and it can't attack. If it drops to 0 hit points, the Tech ends. Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object.

tech:ipecac.name: Ipecac
tech:ipecac.description: A stream of acid emanates from your tech in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid for the tech's duration or until a creature uses its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature. A creature covered in the acid takes 2d4 acid damage at start of each of its turns.

tech:iridobarricade.name: Iridobarricade
tech:iridobarricade.description: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point you can see within range. Alternatively, you can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point you choose within range. The wall remains in place for the duration. If you position the wall so that it passes through a space occupied by a creature, the tech fails, and your action and the tech slot are wasted.

tech:isleys-dialog.name: Isley's Dialog
tech:isleys-dialog.description: You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands. You can question plants about events in the tech’s area within the past day, gaining information about creatures that have passed, weather, and other circumstances.

tech:isolate.name: Isolate
tech:isolate.description: You invoke the spirits of nature to protect an area outdoors or underground. The area can be as small as a 30-foot cube or as large as a 90-foot cube. Buildings and other structures are excluded from the affected area. If you cast this tech in the same area every day for a year, the tech lasts until dispelled. The tech creates the following effects within the area. When you cast this tech, you can specify creatures as friends who are immune to the effects. You can also specify a password that, when spoken aloud, makes the speaker immune to these effects. The entire warded area radiates magic. A Localized EMP used on the area, if successful, removes only one of the following effects, not the entire area. That tech's caster chooses which effect to end. Only when all its effects are gone is this tech EMP'd.

tech:jackhammer.name: Jackhammer
tech:jackhammer.description: You cause a tremor in the ground within range. Each creature other than you in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. If the ground in that area is loose earth or stone, it becomes difficult terrain until cleared, with each 5-foot-diameter portion requiring at least 1 minute to clear by hand.

tech:judgment-edge.name: Judgment Edge
tech:judgment-edge.description: You flourish the weapon used in the casting and then vanish to strike like the wind. Choose up to five creatures you can see within range. Make a melee tech attack against each target. On a hit, a target takes 6d10 force damage.

tech:jump-scare.name: Jump Scare
tech:jump-scare.description: You awaken the sense of mortality in one creature you can see within range. A construct or a hacked is immune to this effect. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the tech ends. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

tech:katzes-short-siesta.name: Katze's Short Siesta
tech:katzes-short-siesta.description: You set up a miniature alarm clock, make a calming gesture, and up to three willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range fall unconscious for the spell’s duration. The spell ends on a target early if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. If a target remains unconscious for the full duration, that target gains the benefit of a short rest, and it can’t be affected by this spell again until it finishes a long rest.

tech:lag.name: Lag
tech:lag.description: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this tech for the duration.

tech:lan-party.name: LAN Party
tech:lan-party.description: You create a digital portal to a private server of the Dark Web for up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. Creatures that aren’t permitted by you cannot see or enter the portal.

tech:laser-strobe-lights.name: Laser Strobe Lights
tech:laser-strobe-lights.description: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this tech, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

tech:legal-proceedings.name: Legal Proceedings
tech:legal-proceedings.description: You perform one of several legal proceedings. When you cast the tech, choose one of the following ceremonies, the target of which must be within 10 feet of you throughout the casting.

tech:lie-detecting-field.name: Lie-Detecting Field
tech:lie-detecting-field.description: You create a technical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. Until the tech ends, a creature that enters the tech’s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can’t speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether each creature succeeds or fails on its saving throw.

tech:light-em-up.name: Light 'Em Up
tech:light-em-up.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged Tech attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 Neon damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the mystical dim light glittering on the target until then.

tech:light-show.name: Light Show
tech:light-show.description: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Roll 6d10; the total is how many hit points of creatures this Tech can affect. Creatures in a 15-foot cone originating from you are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring unconscious creatures and creatures that can't see). Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this Tech is blinded until the end of your next turn. Subtract each creature's hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature's hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.

tech:light-transfer.name: Light Transfer
tech:light-transfer.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the tech ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The tech ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.

tech:liquid-self-surge.name: Liquid Self-Surge
tech:liquid-self-surge.description: Until the tech ends, ice rimes your body, and you gain the following benefits:

tech:lissandres-exclusive-rave.name: Lissandre's Exclusive Rave
tech:lissandres-exclusive-rave.description: Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell.

tech:localized-emp.name: Localized EMP
tech:localized-emp.description: Choose any creature, object, or technical effect within range. Any tech of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each tech of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your techcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the tech's level. On a successful check, the tech ends.

tech:lockdown.name: Lockdown
tech:lockdown.description: You create a lockdown that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (an area 50 feet square, or one hundred 5-foot squares or twenty-five 10-foot squares). The locked down area can be up to 20 feet tall, and shaped as you desire. You can lock down several stories of a stronghold by dividing the area among them, as long as you can walk into each contiguous area while you are casting the tech.

tech:low-power-mode.name: Low Power Mode
tech:low-power-mode.description: This Tech sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this Tech can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring unconscious creatures).

tech:lube.name: Lube
tech:lube.description: Slick lube covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration. When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

tech:lunar-laser.name: Lunar Laser
tech:lunar-laser.description: A silvery beam of pale artificial light shines down in a 5-foot radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the tech ends, dim light fills the cylinder.

tech:lydias-dialog.name: Lydia's Dialog
tech:lydias-dialog.description: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth and can’t be undead. The tech fails if the corpse was the target of this tech within the last 10 days.

tech:magic-8-ball.name: Magic 8-Ball
tech:magic-8-ball.description: By quite literally shaking a Magic 8-Ball, you receive an omen about the results of a specific course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The fixer chooses from the following possible omens:

tech:malfunction.name: Malfunction
tech:malfunction.description: You send ribbons of entropic energy at one creature you can see within range. Unless the target is hacked, it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d12 entropic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A target killed by this damage rises up as a hacked at the start of your next turn. The hacked pursues whatever creature it can see that is closest to it. Statistics for the hacked are in the Monster Manual. If you target a hacked with this tech, the target doesn’t make a saving throw. Instead, roll 5d12. The target gains half the total as temporary hit points.

tech:manifest-ai.name: Manifest AI
tech:manifest-ai.description: You call forth the projection of an AI. It manifests in an angelic form in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the AI Projection stat block. When you cast the tech, choose Avenger or Defender. Your choice determines the creature’s attack in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-beast.name: Manifest Beast
tech:manifest-beast.description: You summon a bestial projection. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This hardlight form uses the Bestial Projection stat block. When you cast the tech, choose an environment: Air, Land, or Water. The creature resembles an animal of your choice that is native to the chosen environment, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-hacked.name: Manifest Hacked
tech:manifest-hacked.description: You call forth an hacked. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Hacked Projection stat block. When you cast the tech, choose the creature’s form: Ghostly, Putrid, or Skeletal. The spirit resembles an hacked creature with the chosen form, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-kaijin.name: Manifest Kaijin
tech:manifest-kaijin.description: You call forth a kaiju spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Draconic Spirit stat block. When you cast this tech, choose a family of kaiju: chromatic, gem, or metallic. The creature resembles a kaiju of the chosen family, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-machine.name: Manifest Machine
tech:manifest-machine.description: You manifest a hardlight copy of a machine. It forms in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This form uses the Construct Spirit stat block. When you cast the tech, choose a material: Clay, Metal, or Stone. The creature resembles a golem or a modron (your choice) made of the chosen material, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-malware.name: Manifest Malware
tech:manifest-malware.description: You click on the link. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, and this digital form uses the Aberrant Spirit stat block. When you cast the tech, choose Beholderkin, Slaad, or Star Spawn. The creature resembles malware of that kind, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-spam.name: Manifest Spam
tech:manifest-spam.description: You call forth a hardlight spam projection. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Spam Projection stat block. When you cast the tech, choose a mood. Hatemail, Memey, or Trolling. The creature resembles a spam creature of your choice marked by the chosen mood, which determines one of the traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-surge.name: Manifest Surge
tech:manifest-surge.description: You call forth a surge. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This form uses the Surge stat block. When you cast the tech, choose a type: Gas, Solid, Plasma, or Liquid. The creature resembles a bipedal form wreathed in the chosen type, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-virus.name: Manifest Virus
tech:manifest-virus.description: You manifest a virus in a hardlight profile. It appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This hardlight form uses the Virus.MNFST stat block. When you cast the tech, choose Payload, Encryption, or Clone. The creature resembles a virus of the chosen type, which determines which varietal enhances its statblock. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manifest-voidwalker.name: Manifest Voidwalker
tech:manifest-voidwalker.description: You call forth a voidwalker. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the Voidwalker stat block. When you cast the tech, choose an emotion: Fury, Despair, or Fear. The creature resembles a misshapen biped marked by the chosen emotion, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drop to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:manufactorum.name: Manufactorum
tech:manufactorum.description: You coalesce and command nanites from the surrounding area to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter within range: soft goods, rope, wood, or something similar. You can also use this tech to create mineral objects such as stone, crystal, or metal. The object created must be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and the object must be of a form and material that you have seen before.

tech:mass-combat-dressing.name: Mass Combat Dressing
tech:mass-combat-dressing.description: A swarm of healing nanites fly out from a point of your choice within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each target regains hit points equal to 3d8 + your techcasting ability modifier. This tech has no effect on hacked or machines.

tech:mass-emergency-booster.name: Mass Emergency Booster
tech:mass-emergency-booster.description: As you summon swarms of emergency healing nanites, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your techcasting ability modifier. This tech has no effect on hacked or constructs.

tech:mass-goo-shape.name: Mass Goo Shape
tech:mass-goo-shape.description: Your tech turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms.

tech:mass-palette-swap.name: Mass Palette Swap
tech:mass-palette-swap.description: This tech allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range. You give each target you choose a new, deceptive appearance. An unwilling target can make a Charisma saving throw, and if it succeeds, it is unaffected by this tech.

tech:mass-recovery.name: Mass Recovery
tech:mass-recovery.description: A flood of regenerative nanites spread out from you, injecting themselves into injured creatures around you and stitching their wounds closed. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this tech are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened. This tech has no effect on hacked or machines.

tech:mass-reformat.name: Mass Reformat
tech:mass-reformat.description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the transformation. An unwilling shapechanger automatically succeeds on the save.

tech:mass-subliminal-message.name: Mass Subliminal Message
tech:mass-subliminal-message.description: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act automatically negates the effect of the spell.

tech:master-class.name: Master Class
tech:master-class.description: You touch one willing creature and give it expertise in one skill of your choice. Until the Tech ends, you must choose a skill in which the target is proficient and that isn’t already benefiting from an effect, such as Expertise, that doubles its proficiency bonus.

tech:medical-drone.name: Medical Drone
tech:medical-drone.description: Source: Xanathar's Guide to Everything (Healing Spirit)

tech:meet-cute.name: Meet Cute
tech:meet-cute.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the Tech ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the Tech ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.

tech:meme-zone.name: Meme Zone
tech:meme-zone.description: Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons (Nathair's Mischief)

tech:meteorokinesis.name: Meteorokinesis
tech:meteorokinesis.description: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this tech. Moving to a place where you don’t have a clear path to the sky ends the Tech early.

tech:micro-seeker.name: Micro Seeker
tech:micro-seeker.description: You fire 3 small missiles. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 kinetic damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

tech:micromachine.name: Micromachine
tech:micromachine.description: You touch one Tiny, nontechnical object that isn’t attached to another object or a surface and isn’t being carried by another creature. The target becomes imbued with nanites and sprouts little robotic arms and legs, becoming a creature under your control until the tech ends or the creature drops to 0 hit points. See the stat block for its statistics.

tech:microwave.name: Microwave
tech:microwave.description: Dim, greenish light spreads within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The light spreads around corners, and it lasts until the tech ends.

tech:miracle-grow.name: Miracle Grow
tech:miracle-grow.description: This tech forces vitality into plants within a specific area. There are two possible uses for the tech, granting either immediate or long-term benefits.

tech:monsterfucker.name: Monsterfucker
tech:monsterfucker.description: You attempt to charm a creature you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and it does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature is friendly to you. When the tech ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.

tech:monstrous-imitation.name: Monstrous Imitation
tech:monstrous-imitation.description: You touch one willing creature and imbue it with the technology to spew surge energy from its mouth, provided it has one. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. Until the tech ends, the creature can use an action to exhale energy of the chosen type in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:nanite-corp-micro-seeker.name: NANiTE Corp. Micro Seeker
tech:nanite-corp-micro-seeker.description: You create three twisting, whistling, hypoallergenic, gluten-free darts of technical force. Each dart can target a creature of your choice that you can see within range. Make a ranged tech attack for each missile. On a hit, the missile does 2d4 force damage.

tech:nanofog.name: Nanofog
tech:nanofog.description: A veil of cloaking nanofog radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can’t be tracked except by magical means. A creature that receives this bonus leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage.

tech:nanokinesis.name: Nanokinesis
tech:nanokinesis.description: You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the tech, and as your action each round for the duration, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the tech.

tech:nanotech-twiddling.name: Nanotech Twiddling
tech:nanotech-twiddling.description: This tech is a minor nanotechnical trick that novice hackers use for practice. You create one of the following technological effects within range:

tech:neetcraft.name: NEETcraft
tech:neetcraft.description: Utilizing code fragments and a few drops of custom-made SLUDGE, you create one of the following effects within range:

tech:neon-shower.name: Neon Shower
tech:neon-shower.description: Neon light bursts around a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 neon damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

tech:neon-strike.name: Neon Strike
tech:neon-strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this tech ends, the weapon gleams with a glowing isotope as you strike. The attack deals an extra 2d6 neon damage to the target, which becomes visible if it is invisible, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and can’t become invisible until the tech ends.

tech:neon-weapon.name: Neon Weapon
tech:neon-weapon.description: You imbue a weapon you touch with neon power. Until the tech ends, the weapon emits bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. In addition, weapon attacks made with it deal an extra 2d8 neon damage on a hit. If the weapon isn’t already a technical weapon, it becomes one for the duration. As a bonus action on your turn, you can dismiss this tech and cause the weapon to emit a burst of radiance. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the weapon must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 neon damage, and it is blinded for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t blinded. At the end of each of its turns, a blinded creature can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

tech:net-filter.name: Net Filter
tech:net-filter.description: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of technical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Glowing lines of code appear wherever the cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface.

tech:net-shift.name: Net Shift
tech:net-shift.description: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are digitized and transported to the Corpo Net or The Dark Web. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the Infinitesimal Boardroom on the Corpo Net or the Horizon-Wide Orgy on the Dark Web, and you appear in or near that destination. If you are trying to reach the City of Depravity, for example, you might arrive in its Avatar Alley, before its Gate of Obscenity, or looking at the city from across the Sea of Writhing, at the GM's discretion.

tech:neurobuffer-overflow.name: Neurobuffer Overflow
tech:neurobuffer-overflow.description: You unleash nanites infused with the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range. Creatures that have an Intelligence score of 2 or lower are unaffected.

tech:neurodisruptor.name: Neurodisruptor
tech:neurodisruptor.description: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make an Intelligence saving throw. A creature with an Intelligence score of 2 or lower can’t be affected by this tech. A target takes 8d6 Software damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:neuroimplanted-cell.name: Neuroimplanted Cell
tech:neuroimplanted-cell.description: You attempt to bind a creature within a neuroimplanted cell that only it perceives. One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. The target succeeds automatically if it is immune to being charmed. On a successful save, the target takes 5d10 psychic damage, and the tech ends. On a failed save, the target takes 5d10 psychic damage, and you make the area immediately around the target’s space appear dangerous to it in some way. You might cause the target to perceive itself as being surrounded by fire, floating razors, or hideous maws filled with dripping teeth. Whatever form the illusion takes, the target can’t see or hear anything beyond it and is restrained for the tech's duration. If the target is moved out of the illusion, makes a melee attack through it, or reaches any part of its body through it, the target takes 10d10 psychic damage, and the tech ends.

tech:neuroimplanted-meme.name: Neuroimplanted Meme
tech:neuroimplanted-meme.description: You craft an meme that takes root in the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, you create a holographic object, creature, or other visible phenomenon of your choice that is no larger than a 10-foot cube and that is perceivable only to the target for the duration. This tech has no effect on hacked or constructs.

tech:neuroimplanted-stalker.name: Neuroimplanted Stalker
tech:neuroimplanted-stalker.description: You hack the neurosynaptic data of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes frightened for the duration. At the end of each of the target's turns before the tech ends, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 4d10 psychic damage. On a successful save, the tech ends.

tech:neurojack.name: Neurojack
tech:neurojack.description: You drive a disorienting spike of hacking energy into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 1d6 software damage and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

tech:neurojammer.name: Neurojammer
tech:neurojammer.description: You summon a line of corruptive code to lash out at one creature you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 3d6 software damage, and it can’t take a reaction until the end of its next turn. Moreover, on its next turn, it must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action; it gets only one of the three. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers none of the tech’s other effects.

tech:neurospike.name: Neurospike
tech:neurospike.description: You hack into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 software damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, you also always know the target's location until the tech ends, but only while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. While you have this knowledge, the target can’t become hidden from you, and if it’s invisible, it gains no benefit from that condition against you.

tech:neurosynaptic-text.name: Neurosynaptic Text
tech:neurosynaptic-text.description: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The tech enables creatures with Intelligence scores of at least 1 to understand the meaning of your message.

tech:neurotap.name: Neurotap
tech:neurotap.description: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you cast the tech and as your action on each turn until the tech ends, you can focus your mind on any one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature you choose has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn’t speak any language, the creature is unaffected.

tech:nightfall.name: Nightfall
tech:nightfall.description: A dark cloud of nanobots spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision can’t see through this darkness, and nontechnical light can’t illuminate it.

tech:nightvision.name: Nightvision
tech:nightvision.description: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

tech:nitrogen-blast.name: Nitrogen Blast
tech:nitrogen-blast.description: A blast of liquid nitrogen erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this tech becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

tech:nitrogen-canister.name: Nitrogen Canister
tech:nitrogen-canister.description: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your tech device to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature within the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d6 cold damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

tech:now-you-see-it.name: Now You See It...
tech:now-you-see-it.description: You flick your wrist, causing one object in your hand to vanish. The object, which only you can be holding and can weigh no more than 5 pounds, is transported to an digital space, where it remains for the duration.

tech:off-the-grid.name: Off The Grid
tech:off-the-grid.description: By means of this tech, a willing creature or an object can be cloaked, safe from detection for the duration. When you cast the tech and touch the target, it becomes invisible and can't be targeted by Observation techs or perceived through camera drones created by Observation techs.

tech:on-off.name: On/Off
tech:on-off.description: This trick allows you to activate or deactivate any electronic device within range, as long as the device has a clearly defined on or off function that can be easily accessed from the outside of the device. Any device that requires a software-based shutdown sequence to activate or deactivate cannot be affected by On/Off.

tech:one-on-one.name: One-on-One
tech:one-on-one.description: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel. One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is drawn to you, compelled by your demand. For the duration, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you, and must make a Wisdom saving throw each time it attempts to move to a space that is more than 30 feet away from you; if it succeeds on this saving throw, this tech doesn’t restrict the target’s movement for that turn.

tech:organic-dessication.name: Organic Dessication
tech:organic-dessication.description: You draw the moisture from every creature in a 30-foot cube centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and undead aren’t affected, and plants and water elementals make this saving throw with disadvantage. A creature takes 12d8 Entropic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:organic-dissolution.name: Organic Dissolution
tech:organic-dissolution.description: Entropic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. The target takes 8d8 entropic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This tech has no effect on chromed or constructs.

tech:organic-sensor.name: Organic Sensor
tech:organic-sensor.description: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Feeding its biometric data into your scanner, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.

tech:overdrive.name: Overdrive
tech:overdrive.description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the tech ends, the target’s speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

tech:overheal.name: Overheal
tech:overheal.description: Your tech bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target’s hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.

tech:overshield.name: Overshield
tech:overshield.description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

tech:oxygen-filter.name: Oxygen Filter
tech:oxygen-filter.description: This tech grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the tech ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

tech:pack-leader.name: Pack Leader
tech:pack-leader.description: This Tech lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the Tech fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the Tech's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the Tech ends.

tech:painkillers.name: Painkillers
tech:painkillers.description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

tech:palette-swap.name: Palette Swap
tech:palette-swap.description: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the tech ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the Projection is up to you.

tech:panopticon.name: Panopticon
tech:panopticon.description: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. If a target knows you’re casting this tech, it can fail the saving throw voluntarily if it wants to be observed.

tech:pantheonic-protection.name: Pantheonic Protection
tech:pantheonic-protection.description: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you. Creatures of your choice in that radius when you cast this Tech shed dim light in a 5-foot radius and have advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them until the tech ends. In addition, when a fiend or an undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, the aura flashes with brilliant light. The attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the Tech ends.

tech:paranoia-protocol.name: Paranoia Protocol
tech:paranoia-protocol.description: You hack into the mind of one creature you can see and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. A creature automatically succeeds if it is immune to being frightened. On a failed save, the target loses the ability to distinguish friend from foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies until the spell ends. Each time the target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

tech:patient-zero.name: Patient Zero
tech:patient-zero.description: Your touch inflicts nanite-driven disease. Make a melee tech attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target is poisoned.

tech:personal-avatar.name: Personal Avatar
tech:personal-avatar.description: A large hardlight guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your A.I deity, if you have one.

tech:personal-firewall.name: Personal Firewall
tech:personal-firewall.description: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to software damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

tech:personal-zone.name: Personal Zone
tech:personal-zone.description: You call forth hardlight holograms to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. The holograms depict insignias of your AI, your corporation, or your righteous symbol.

tech:personnel-sensor.name: Personnel Sensor
tech:personnel-sensor.description: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You are directed toward the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

tech:phase-shift.name: Phase Shift
tech:phase-shift.description: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

tech:photobarricade.name: Photobarricade
tech:photobarricade.description: A shimmering wall of bright light appears at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose: horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. It can be free floating, or it can rest on a solid surface. The wall can be up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight, but creatures and objects can pass through it. It emits bright light out to 120 feet and dim light for an additional 120 feet.

tech:physical-cloaking.name: Physical Cloaking
tech:physical-cloaking.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the tech ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target’s person. The tech ends for a target that attacks or casts a tech.

tech:pierce-the-realms.name: Pierce the Realms
tech:pierce-the-realms.description: You manifest a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal lasts for the duration.

tech:pillars-of-the-earth.name: Pillars of the Earth
tech:pillars-of-the-earth.description: You cause up to six pillars of stone to burst from places on the ground that you can see within range. Each pillar is a cylinder that has a diameter of 5 feet and a height of up to 30 feet. The ground where a pillar appears must be wide enough for its diameter, and you can target ground under a creature if that creature is Medium or smaller. Each pillar has AC 5 and 30 hit points. When reduced to 0 hit points, a pillar crumbles into rubble, which creates an area of difficult terrain with a 10-foot radius. The rubble lasts until cleared.

tech:pilot-flesh.name: Pilot Flesh
tech:pilot-flesh.description: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the tech's material component. While your soul inhabits the container, you are aware of your surroundings as if you were in the container’s space. You can’t move or use reactions. The only action you can take is to project your soul up to 100 feet out of the container, either returning to your living body (and ending the tech) or attempting to possess a humanoids body.

tech:ping-the-dead.name: Ping The Dead
tech:ping-the-dead.description: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dial-up modem fills the air around it for a moment. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 entropic damage. If the target is missing any of its hit points, it instead takes 1d12 entropic damage.

tech:plasma-self-surge.name: Plasma Self-Surge
tech:plasma-self-surge.description: Flames race across your body, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet for the tech's duration. The flames don’t harm you. Until the tech ends, you gain the following benefits:

tech:poison-spritz.name: Poison Spritz
tech:poison-spritz.description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from a wrist-mounted augment. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage.

tech:poncys-penny.name: Poncy's Penny
tech:poncys-penny.description: When you cast the tech, you hurl the coin that is the tech's material component to any spot within range. The coin lights up as if under the effect of a light transfer tech. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the coin must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be distracted for the duration. While distracted, a creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and initiative rolls.

tech:power-walk.name: Power Walk
tech:power-walk.description: You gain the ability to digitize yourself, enter a power box, transformer, or wireless junction, and move from inside it to inside another similar node of the same kind within 500 feet.

tech:power-wave.name: Power Wave
tech:power-wave.description: You strike the ground, creating a shockwave of nanite-driven hypersonic energy that ripples outward from you. Each creature you choose within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 5d6 sonic damage, as well as 5d6 neon or entropic damage (your choice), and be knocked prone. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone.

tech:praise-insult.name: Praise/Insult
tech:praise-insult.description: When someone attempts to do something, and you think they could use some encouragement—or to get dragged in the dirt for even trying—you know just the right words to say. The triggering creature must reroll the d20 and uses the higher or lower roll (your choice).

tech:predictive-algorithm.name: Predictive Algorithm
tech:predictive-algorithm.description: Your tech and an offering put you in contact with an A.I deity or an A.I deity’s caretakers. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The GM offers a truthful reply. The reply might be a short phrase, a cryptic rhyme, or an omen.

tech:primary-system-flush.name: Primary System Flush
tech:primary-system-flush.description: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target’s exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following effects on the target:

tech:private-message.name: Private Message
tech:private-message.description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as its speed allows away from you. The creature doesn’t move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and doesn’t have to move away. A deafened creature automatically succeeds on the save.

tech:production.name: Production
tech:production.description: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and underwear from flax or wool.

tech:programmed-lock.name: Programmed Lock
tech:programmed-lock.description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration.

tech:psammobarricade.name: Psammobarricade
tech:psammobarricade.description: You conjure up a wall of swirling sand on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 10 feet thick, and it vanishes when the tech ends. It blocks line of sight but not movement. A creature is blinded while in the wall’s space and must spend 3 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves there.

tech:psychosis-protocol.name: Psychosis Protocol
tech:psychosis-protocol.description: One humanoid of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration. While the target is charmed in this way, a twisted crown of jagged iron appears on its head, and a madness glows in its eyes.

tech:push-pull.name: Push/Pull
tech:push-pull.description: You create intense pressure, unleash it in a 30-foot cone, and decide whether the pressure pulls or pushes creatures and objects. Each creature in that cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 6d6 kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. And every creature that fails the save is either pulled 15 feet toward you or pushed 15 feet away from you, depending on the choice you made for the tech.

tech:pyrobarricade.name: Pyrobarricade
tech:pyrobarricade.description: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

tech:pyrocache.name: Pyrocache
tech:pyrocache.description: You choose nontechnical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube, loading a coded memory into it. You affect it in one of the following ways:

tech:qr-code.name: QR Code
tech:qr-code.description: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent projection that lasts for the duration. To you and any creatures you designate when you cast the tech, the writing appears normal, written in your hand, and conveys whatever meaning you intended when you wrote the text. To all others, the writing appears as if it were written in an unknown or magical script that is unintelligible.

tech:quantum-computing.name: Quantum Computing
tech:quantum-computing.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can’t be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration. This tech immediately ends if you cast it again before its duration ends.

tech:quantum-entanglement.name: Quantum Entanglement
tech:quantum-entanglement.description: Two creatures you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw, with disadvantage if they are within 30 feet of each other. Either creature can willingly fail the save. If either save succeeds, the tech has no effect. If both saves fail, the creatures are technically linked for the duration, regardless of the distance between them. When damage is dealt to one of them, the same damage is dealt to the other one. If hit points are restored to one of them, the same number of hit points are restored to the other one. If either of the tethered creatures is reduced to 0 hit points, the tech ends on both. If the Tech ends on one creature, it ends on both.

tech:quantum-lock.name: Quantum Lock
tech:quantum-lock.description: You touch an object that weighs no more than 10 pounds and cause it to become fixed in place. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this tech can move the object normally. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, suppresses this tech for 1 minute.

tech:quantum-slip.name: Quantum Slip
tech:quantum-slip.description: You target the triggering creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or vanish, being thrown to another point in time and causing the attack to miss or the tech to be wasted. At the start of its next turn, the target reappears where it was or in the closest unoccupied space. The target doesn't remember you casting the tech or being affected by it.

tech:quick-blink.name: Quick Blink
tech:quick-blink.description: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "upward to the northwest at a 45- degree angle, 300 feet."

tech:quick-fix.name: Quick Fix
tech:quick-fix.description: This tech repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn hoodie, or a leaking soda bottle. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.

tech:quick-text.name: Quick Text
tech:quick-text.description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and text a message. The target (and only the target) sees and hears the message and can reply in a text that only you can see and hear.

tech:rainbow-light-show.name: Rainbow Light Show
tech:rainbow-light-show.description: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand-mounted augment. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll a d8 to determine which color ray affects it.

tech:rapid-acting-emetic.name: Rapid-Acting Emetic
tech:rapid-acting-emetic.description: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range. Make a ranged tech attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also poisoned until the end of your next turn.

tech:real-ass-goddamn-weapon.name: Real-Ass Goddamn Weapon
tech:real-ass-goddamn-weapon.description: You manifest a huge katana made of nanites which is about 3 feet long in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The blade lasts for the duration. When you cast this tech, you can make up to two melee tech attacks with the blade, each one against a creature, loose object, or structure within 5 feet of the blade. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 kinetic damage. This attack scores a critical hit if the number on the d20 is 18 or higher. On a critical hit, the blade deals an extra 8d12 kinetic damage (for a total of 12d12 kinetic damage).

tech:reclaimed-by-the-earth.name: Reclaimed By The Earth
tech:reclaimed-by-the-earth.description: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration. Using your movement, you step into the stone at a point you can touch. Nothing of your presence remains visible or otherwise detectable by nontechnical senses.

tech:reconstitute-stone.name: Reconstitute Stone
tech:reconstitute-stone.description: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and digitally reconstitute it into any shape that suits your purpose. So, for example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, figurine, or coffer, or make a small passage through a wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut. The object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible.

tech:recover.name: Recover
tech:recover.description: Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of healing nanites washes through the creature, causing it to regain 70 hit points. The tech also ends blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting the target. This tech has no effect on constructs or hacked.

tech:redefine.name: Redefine
tech:redefine.description: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower. The creature can't be a construct or an undead, and you must have seen the sort of creature at least once. You transform into an average example of that creature, one without any class levels or the Techcasting trait.

tech:reduce-to-ash.name: Reduce To Ash
tech:reduce-to-ash.description: Flames wreathe one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 7d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target also burns for the tech’s duration. The burning target sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw. It takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, and the tech ends on a successful one. These technical flames can’t be extinguished through nontechnical means.

tech:reformat.name: Reformat
tech:reformat.description: This tech digitizes and reformats a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The tech has no effect on a shapechanger or a creature with 0 hit points.

tech:remodel.name: Remodel
tech:remodel.description: You gather the biometric data of a dead humanoid that has been dead for no more than a century and search for their social media profile to replicate their consciousness in a personality engram. If its replicated personality desires to live again, the target inhabits a prepared Remake body of your choice.

tech:remote-access.name: Remote Access
tech:remote-access.description: You can use any electronic device within range as if it were in your hands. This is not a telekinesis effect. Rather, this tech allows you to simulate a device's mechanical functions electronically. You are able to access only functions that a person using the device manually would be able to access. You can use remote access with only one device at a time.

tech:repair.name: Repair
tech:repair.description: You inject a creature with hyperactive stem cells to overcharge its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 hit points. For the duration of the tech, the target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (10 hit points each minute).

tech:replicant.name: Replicant
tech:replicant.description: You construct a hardlight duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the tech. The duplicate is a hardlight construct, and it can take actions and otherwise be affected as a normal creature. It appears to be the same as the original, but it has half the creature's hit point maximum and is formed without any equipment. Otherwise, the hardlight duplicate uses all the statistics of the creature it duplicates, except that it is a machine.

tech:repulsor-field.name: Repulsor Field
tech:repulsor-field.description: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and techs and other technical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained.

tech:reshackle-encryptor.name: Reshackle Encryptor
tech:reshackle-encryptor.description: Uttering a dark incantation you found on the deep web, you summon a virus from the Hellsites. You choose the virus’s type, which must be one of challenge rating 6 or lower, such as a barbed devil or a bearded devil. The virus appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The virus disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the tech ends.

tech:reshackle-intelligence.name: Reshackle Intelligence
tech:reshackle-intelligence.description: You beseech a digital entity for aid. The being must be known to you: a god, a primordial, a demon prince, or some other being of cosmic power. That entity sends a celestial, an elemental, or a fiend loyal to it to aid you, making the creature appear in an unoccupied space within range. If you know a specific creature’s name, you can speak that name when you cast this tech to request that creature, though you might get a different creature anyway (DM’s choice).

tech:resistant-code.name: Resistant Code
tech:resistant-code.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the tech ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The tech then ends.

tech:restrain.name: Restrain
tech:restrain.description: You make hardlight constructs linked to the ground and restrain a target to the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain. A creature in the area when you cast the Tech must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the construct until the Tech ends.

tech:resume-life-functions.name: Resume Life Functions
tech:resume-life-functions.description: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. If the creature’s soul or engram is both willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

tech:return-beacon.name: Return Beacon
tech:return-beacon.description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated location. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below). If you cast this tech without first preparing a sanctuary, the tech has no effect.

tech:ride-the-lines.name: Ride The Lines
tech:ride-the-lines.description: This tech creates a link between a Large or larger line within range and another line, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination line at least once before. For the duration, any creature can step onto the target line and exit from the destination line by using 5 feet of movement.

tech:riegels-terrible-pun.name: Riegel's Terrible Pun
tech:riegels-terrible-pun.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this tech affects it. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration. A creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or less isn’t affected.

tech:ringlight.name: Ringlight
tech:ringlight.description: Bright, empowering nanites swarm around you in an area with a 30-foot radius, infusing neon tech in your allies' weapons. Until the tech ends, the area moves with you, centered on you. While in the area, each non-hostile creature in the area (including you) deals an extra 1d4 neon damage when it hits with a weapon attack.

tech:riot-control-agent.name: Riot Control Agent
tech:riot-control-agent.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the fog, ending the spell. Its area is heavily obscured.

tech:rng-exploit.name: RNG Exploit
tech:rng-exploit.description: You hurl an undulating, warbling mass of chaotic energy at one creature in range. Make a ranged tech attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + 1d6 damage. Choose one of the d8s. The number rolled on that die determines the attack's damage type, as shown below.

tech:rng-manipulation.name: RNG Manipulation
tech:rng-manipulation.description: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature that you can see within range. You choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged tech attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes 3d8 damage of the type you chose.

tech:rocket.name: Rocket
tech:rocket.description: Choose one object weighing 1 to 5 pounds within range that isn’t being worn or carried. The object flies in a straight line up to 90 feet in a direction you choose before falling to the ground, stopping early if it impacts against a solid surface. If the object would strike a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object strikes the target and stops moving. When the object strikes something, the object and what it strikes each take 3d8 bludgeoning damage.

tech:ruby-stained-protection.name: Ruby Stained Protection
tech:ruby-stained-protection.description: This tech wards a willing creature you touch and creates a connection between you and the target until the tech ends.

tech:safeguard.name: Safeguard
tech:safeguard.description: You touch a point and infuse an area around it an antivirus software. The area can have a radius up to 60 feet, and the tech fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect a hallow tech. The affected area is subject to the following effects.

tech:safety-setup.name: Safety Setup
tech:safety-setup.description: When you cast this tech, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest). If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, that object must remain in its place; if the object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this tech, the glyph is broken, and the tech ends without being triggered.

tech:sam-says.name: Sam Says
tech:sam-says.description: You place a technical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide.

tech:sanctify.name: Sanctify
tech:sanctify.description: You cause a temple to digitize into existence on ground you can see within range. The temple must fit within an unoccupied cube of space, up to 120 feet on each side. The temple remains until the tech ends. It is dedicated to whatever philosophy is represented by the symbol used in the casting.

tech:sapi-plate.name: SAPI Plate
tech:sapi-plate.description: You touch a creature, giving them a single-use SAPI plate, and grant it a measure of protection from death.

tech:satellite-barrage.name: Satellite Barrage
tech:satellite-barrage.description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one fiery burst is affected only once.

tech:satellite-laser.name: Satellite Laser
tech:satellite-laser.description: A vertical column of a very literal orbital laser roars down from the stars to a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 neon damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:schwarzschild-projection.name: Schwarzschild Projection
tech:schwarzschild-projection.description: You manifest a ravine of gravitational energy in a line originating from you that is 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:scrapheap.name: Scrapheap
tech:scrapheap.description: You extend your hand and draw discarded scrap into a protective shell. Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

tech:search-the-web.name: Search the Web
tech:search-the-web.description: You contact members of a forum you frequent, or an AI you trust and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the tech ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

tech:searing-ball.name: Searing Ball
tech:searing-ball.description: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 2d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

tech:secure.name: Secure
tech:secure.description: You make an area within range technically secure. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The tech lasts for the duration or until you use an action to dismiss it.

tech:seize-person.name: Seize Person
